$comment: English texts of data/regions.json (src/engine/overlay.js): each region's card (name, description, land, trait), as the Combat tab shows them all, and its places. The name of a land is the same in all of its regions, as the casino groups the places of a land by it (src/engine/casino.js).

windfalls.name: Windfalls
windfalls.description: A belt of fallen trees on the edge of the wilds. Wolves, boars, deer and ravens, and deep in the thicket a wandering light and a storm-bringing Pwanetnik.

trait.name: Sacred Grove
trait.description: Rest between fights restores 5% more HP.

windfalls-edge.name: Edge of the Windfalls
windfalls-edge.description: A sparse copse by the first fallen trunks. Lone wolves and badgers, grass snakes in the long grass, and squirrels hurling pine cones from the branches.

fox-ravines.name: Fox Ravines
fox-ravines.description: Sandy ravines full of burrows. Foxes hunt here in pairs, martens leap through the trees, raccoon dogs take over the fox dens, and antlions wait at the bottom of sandy pits.

raven-hollows.name: Raven Hollows
raven-hollows.description: Upturned trees with their roots to the sky. Ravens nest on them, a tawny owl hunts at dusk, weasels dart between the roots, and a capercaillie displays in the clearing.

viper-heaps.name: Viper Deadfall
viper-heaps.description: Sun-warmed heaps of trunks. A viper basks on every stone, hornets buzz and stag beetles scrabble in the rotten logs, and a snake eagle circles above the deadfall.

boar-thicket.name: Boar Thicket
boar-thicket.description: The densest part of the Windfalls. Churned earth gives the boars away, deer slip between the trunks, a wildcat lurks in the undergrowth, and a black stork wades in the stream. Tusk marks show on the trunks higher than a man can reach.

stone-glade.name: Stone Glade
stone-glade.description: A clearing with a ring of mossy boulders, beyond which the true wilds begin. Stonelings, spiders, lynxes and packs of she-wolves led by an alpha wolf.

trait.name: Stone Circle
trait.description: The character at the front has 5% more armour.

mossy-boulders.name: Mossy Boulders
mossy-boulders.description: The outer ring of moss-covered stones. Some boulders wake to life, the moss sometimes rises by itself, bats sleep in the cracks, and an imp leaps from stone to stone.

spider-gully.name: Spider Gully
spider-gully.description: A narrow gully shrouded in cobwebs. Spiders wait in their webs, a cross spider strings its nets above the gully, tarantulas hunt among the boulders, a fresh brood pours out from under the stones, and in the deepest burrow lives the birdeater.

lynx-ridge.name: Lynx Ridge
lynx-ridge.description: A rocky ridge above the clearing. Lynxes lurk on the ledges and drop onto their prey from above, mouflons walk the steep paths, an eagle owl circles over them, and a falcon plunges from the sky.

wolf-circles.name: Wolf Circles
wolf-circles.description: Clearings where the packs howl. She-wolves hunt together, led by an alpha wolf. A werewolf runs with the wolves, and a wolf shepherd herds them.

glade-heart.name: Heart of the Glade
glade-heart.description: The middle of the stone circle. Everything here is bigger and more dangerous: a bear lives in the thicket, the last aurochs grazes, an Aesculapian snake winds through the grass, and at night a Strzyga flies. Among the boulders stand stone animals that no one ever carved.

backwaters.name: Overgrown Backwaters
backwaters.description: A valley where an old river lost its bed and spilled across the forest. Herons, beavers, catfish and crocodiles, and in the mist, drowned maidens and the water spirit.

trait.name: Reed Beds
trait.description: The character at the back of the line has 5% more dodge, hiding among the reeds.

reed-beds.name: Reed Marsh
reed-beds.description: A belt of reeds by the first water. Herons wade in the shallows, otters have trodden paths through the reeds, and giant mosquitoes whine above the water. Some clumps of reeds walk on their own.

beaver-dams.name: Beaver Dams
beaver-dams.description: Beavers have dammed the streams and flooded the forest. They defend their lodges, swarms of mosquitoes hang over the water, eels hide in the mud, and an eagle keeps watch from the dead trees.

drowned-forest.name: Drowned Forest
drowned-forest.description: Dead trees stand knee-deep in water. Cormorants perch on the dry branches, a catfish lurks in the shadow of the trunks, and what looks like a log is sometimes a crocodile.

willow-isles.name: Willow Isles
willow-isles.description: Islands of old willows in the mist. Wraiths and mistlings drift between the trunks, phantasms emerge from the vapours, willow spirits rustle in the treetops, and at night a Topielitsa dances on the water.

old-riverbed.name: Old Riverbed
old-riverbed.description: The old bed of the river, deep and dark. Bones lie in the mud, Utopietses and sludgers climb out of the water, and mud goblins collect anything that glitters. Here lives the Vodnik, who keeps the souls of the drowned in jars.

peat-bogs.name: Peat Bogs
peat-bogs.description: Here the water has grown over with moss, and mists hang above the peat. Cranes, elk, leeches and sundews, and between the tussocks, will-o’-the-wisps, the kikimora and the bogman.

trait.name: Peat Fumes
trait.description: Poison lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

crane-meadows.name: Crane Meadows
crane-meadows.description: Open moss bogs where cranes dance and black grouse battle over their courting grounds. Water lies under the moss, so every step sinks, and elk wade here chest-deep.

leech-pools.name: Leech Pools
leech-pools.description: Windows of black water in the peat, full of leeches and crayfish. Diving beetles hunt in the depths, and a marsh harrier circles above the water.

sundew-field.name: Sundew Field
sundew-field.description: Moss red with sundews that catch insects. Peatlings stride between the tussocks, a great owl hunts without a sound at night, and the fumes make your head spin.

smoldering-peat.name: Smouldering Peat
smoldering-peat.description: The peat smoulders underground, and acrid smoke pours from the holes, with a reek hiding in it. At night will-o'-the-wisps wander between the tussocks, salamanders warm themselves in the hot ash, and a Zmey nests in the embers.

old-diggings.name: Old Diggings
old-diggings.description: An abandoned peat pit with log walkways. Peat cutters the bog never gave back still dig here, the Skarbnik wanders with his lantern, worms bore through the walls, rats scurry along the passages, and at the bottom of the pit the peat itself comes alive.

black-bog.name: Black Bog
black-bog.description: The deepest part of the Peatlands, where the water is black as tar. Alders stand here on stilts of roots, the pillars of an old temple rise from the depths, and in a thicket of creeping willow lives the devil Rokita.

trait.name: Healing Mud
trait.description: Healing from skills and potions restores 5% more HP.

pine-dunes.name: Pine Dunes
pine-dunes.description: The first part of the Whispering Pines: dunes overgrown with heather and crooked pines. Further on the resinous forest murmurs, drifting sands bury and uncover old barrows, tar kilns smoke in the hollows, and beyond them lies a blackened burn, circled by the fiery Rarog.

trait.name: Scorching Heat
trait.description: Burn lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

silent-wilds.name: Silent Wilds
silent-wilds.description: A dense spruce wilderness where it is always night and no birds sing, and every hunter waits in hiding for whoever walks last.

trait.name: Thorns
trait.description: Bleeding lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

new-moon-depths.name: New Moon Depths
new-moon-depths.description: The deepest night of the Whispering Pines. The Moon-Eater ate the moon here, old pines rustle without wind, and out of the dark comes what should lie beneath the earth.

trait.name: Ground Frost
trait.description: Chill lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.
